name: Android Execution Skill (MiniAndroid)
source_head: see docs/CAPABILITY_GATE_IDENTITY.json for the exact HEAD/binary pair this manifest was validated at

runtime.data_root: per-run directory passed as --data-root (never shared across unrelated runs)

operations.errors: exit!=0 + stderr '[ERROR] APK parse failed: <reason>' for malformed APKs (loud, never silent)

operations.returns: minSdk, targetSdk, usesFeatures, dangerousPermissions, abiLibs, abiElfMachines, webviewFeatureDeclared, webkitTypesReferenced, nativeAbiVerdict (NO_NATIVE_CODE|EXECUTABLE_NATIVE|ABI_MISMATCH_TRANSLATION_REQUIRED), environmentMismatches[], missingCapabilities[], recommendedNextProbe
operations.errors: APK parse failure passes through loudly; missing manifest still yields environment block
section-level warnings on stderr; JSONL rows machine-readable

operations.returns: JSON identity: package + installed base.apk path; installed SHA == source SHA
operations.errors: INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED for malformed APKs (exit!=0); ARM-only APKs INSTALL OK (honest — see prerequisites.nativeAbiVerdict)

operations.returns: report.md + screenshot.png + trace_summary.json (frame_analysis.verdict/app_owned_pixels/app_draw_ops/first_missing_stage) + lifecycle_trace.json + api trace
operations.errors: exit!=0 on process-death (crash.log carries the chain); PARTIAL SUCCESS verdicts are honest non-SUCCESS

operations.returns: F-NEW-233 frame truth verdict (REAL_APP_CONTENT|DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY|NO_ROOT|...) + pixel class + owned pixels + draw ops
operations.errors: absent trace_summary.json = the run did not execute — treat as error, never success

operations.cli: read <outdir>/run.log (grep 'EXC-PROPAGATE|SYNTH-EXC|REC-MISS') or the diagnostics section of pkginspect on the installed store
operations.returns: first semantic divergence with caller chain — the searchlight entry point

operations.cli: miniandroid/build/miniandroid pkginspect --apk <path> --what prerequisites  →  read .apk.nativeAbiVerdict + .apk.environmentMismatches; then run and read .frame_analysis.verdict
operations.returns: three-way cause: (a) environment-prerequisite mismatch (nativeAbiVerdict=ABI_MISMATCH_TRANSLATION_REQUIRED or non-empty environmentMismatches) (b) ordinary runtime root (prereqs clean + frame verdict non-real: follow first_missing_stage) (c) real content (verdict=REAL_APP_CONTENT)
operations.errors: never guess from a screenshot alone — the verdict is computed from pixel ownership + draw ops

operations.returns: file-IO provenance (physical backing SHA-256 for every runtime write), SQLite header validity, prefs inventory
JSON {"uninstall": "SUCCESS"}; exit 2 + NOT_INSTALLED for unknown packages

execution_levels.L2: launched / lifecycle RESUMED (frame may be background-only)
execution_levels.L4: input → state transition (real input path only)

non_negotiables: No app-specific hacks; fixes are engine/framework laws only
Process survival is NOT success; REAL_APP_CONTENT is computed, not claimed
A screenshot alone is not proof; provenance chain required
Status upgrades require runtime evidence; BLOCKED is an honest answer
